caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure dressed in formal 19th-century attire, including a long overcoat with wide lapels, a vest, buttoned-up shirt, cravat, and trousers. The figure’s left hand is holding a top hat by his side, while the right hand rests beside his thigh. The statue stands on a small, oval pedestal. The entire statue appears in shades of light beige or off-white, creating a marble-like effect, while the background is a solid, flat blue color with a gradient or textured appearance. There are no other objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Figurehead of Andrew Jackson
